title: Dereferencing one allocated integer
description: You can follow a heap address through a write, a read and release.

steps.description: malloc requests enough bytes for one integer. You store its returned address in the integer pointer x.
The null check reports an allocation failure with perror. This branch contains no exit or return before the later dereference.

steps.question: On the successful allocation path, what value does *x read after the assignment?
steps.answer: It reads 5, the integer stored through x at line 12.

steps.description: You see 5 printed in the supplied run. free releases the allocation after its last use.
